name: Data Alteration Green
text:
(This card is always treated as a 'Datashaper' card)
Target 1 Cyberse monster you control, that monster is trated as a Tuner monster until the End Phase, then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon a Cyberse Synchro Monster using that targeted monster and other Cyberse monsters as Synchro Material. If a Special Summoned Cyberse monster you control is destroyed, you can shuffle 1 Synchro Monster from you GY into the Extra Deck, then set this card, but banishit when it leave the field.
